fullText.simplified:
官渡之战（一）

    曹操和元少在一个叫“官渡”的地方，打了第一仗。
    那天，他们站在军队前面，你看我，我看你，说了最后的话。
    曹操说：“元少！你为什么打我？皇帝在我这儿，你打我就是打皇帝。你要做国家的坏人吗？”
    元少说：“曹操！皇帝写信给我，让我打你！国家的坏人是你，你就是第二个董卓！”
    虽然他们说的是真话，但是大家都知道，他们不是为了皇帝打仗。在这个不安静的国家里，皇帝没有军队，皇帝的话没有人听，皇帝一点儿都不重要。曹操和元少把皇帝拿出来说，是为了让自己好看点儿，他们是为了自己打仗。
    曹操和元少开始打了。他们的军队一共有一百万人，这一百万人在官渡打了一年多。他们是国家最厉害的军队，他们打的这一仗也是国家最大的一仗。每天都有人死在官渡，官渡的天都是红色的。
    最后一个月，曹操的粮食快吃完了。没有粮食，军队就不能打仗。曹操很着急，给一个弟弟写信，让弟弟想办法找粮食，这是他最后的希望。
    曹操把信给了一个助手，让他快点儿去送信。但是，这个助手还没有走出官渡，就被元少那边一个叫“许右”的人发现了。
    许右是元少的助手，他拿到曹操的信，看到曹操说没有粮食了，非常高兴。他马上把信拿给元少，让元少去打曹操。但是没想到，元少觉得信不是真的，他说：“如果曹操真的没粮食了，他早就带着军队跑了，怎么还会在官渡？”元少还说许右不聪明，总是做错事。
fullText.traditional:
官渡之戰（一）

    曹操和元少在一個叫“官渡”的地方，打了第一仗。
    那天，他們站在軍隊前面，你看我，我看你，說了最後的話。
    曹操說：“元少！你為什麼打我？皇帝在我這兒，你打我就是打皇帝。你要做國家的壞人嗎？”
    元少說：“曹操！皇帝寫信給我，讓我打你！國家的壞人是你，你就是第二個董卓！”
    雖然他們說的是真話，但是大家都知道，他們不是為了皇帝打仗。在這個不安靜的國家裡，皇帝沒有軍隊，皇帝的話沒有人聽，皇帝一點兒都不重要。曹操和元少把皇帝拿出來說，是為了讓自己好看點兒，他們是為了自己打仗。
    曹操和元少開始打了。他們的軍隊一共有一百萬人，這一百萬人在官渡打了一年多。他們是國家最厲害的軍隊，他們打的這一仗也是國家最大的一仗。每天都有人死在官渡，官渡的天都是紅色的。
    最後一個月，曹操的糧食快吃完了。沒有糧食，軍隊就不能打仗。曹操很著急，給一個弟弟寫信，讓弟弟想辦法找糧食，這是他最後的希望。
    曹操把信給了一個助手，讓他快點兒去送信。但是，這個助手還沒有走出官渡，就被元少那邊一個叫“許右”的人發現了。
    許右是元少的助手，他拿到曹操的信，看到曹操說沒有糧食了，非常高興。他馬上把信拿給元少，讓元少去打曹操。但是沒想到，元少覺得信不是真的，他說：“如果曹操真的沒糧食了，他早就帶著軍隊跑了，怎麼還會在官渡？”元少還說許右不聰明，總是做錯事。

sentences.simplified: 曹操和元少在一个叫“官渡”的地方，打了第一仗。
sentences.traditional: 曹操和元少在一個叫“官渡”的地方，打了第一仗。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo hé yuán shào zài yí ge jiào guān dù de dì fang dǎ le dì yī zhàng
sentences.english: Cao Cao and Yuan Shao fought their first battle in a place called Guandu.

sentences.simplified: 那天，他们站在军队前面，你看我，我看你，说了最后的话。
sentences.traditional: 那天，他們站在軍隊前面，你看我，我看你，說了最後的話。
sentences.pinyin: nà tiān tā men zhàn zài jūn duì qián miàn nǐ kàn wǒ wǒ kàn nǐ shuō le zuì hòu de huà
sentences.english: That day, they stood in front of their troops, looked at each other, and said their last words.

sentences.simplified: 曹操说：“元少！你为什么打我？
sentences.traditional: 曹操說：“元少！你為什麼打我？
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo shuō yuán shào nǐ wèi shén me dǎ wǒ
sentences.english: Cao Cao said, “Yuan Shao! Why are you fighting me?”

sentences.simplified: 皇帝在我这儿，你打我就是打皇帝。你要做国家的坏人吗？”
sentences.traditional: 皇帝在我這兒，你打我就是打皇帝。你要做國家的壞人嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì zài wǒ zhè‘r nǐ dǎ wǒ jiù shì dǎ huáng dì nǐ yào zuò guó jiā de huài rén ma
sentences.english: The emperor is here with me. Fighting me is to fight the emperor. Do you want to be the country’s bad guy?

sentences.simplified: 元少说：“曹操！皇帝写信给我，让我打你！
sentences.traditional: 元少說：“曹操！皇帝寫信給我，讓我打你！
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào shuō cáo cāo huáng dì xiě xìn gěi wǒ ràng wǒ dǎ nǐ
sentences.english: Yuan Shao said, “Cao Cao! The emperor wrote to me and asked me to fight you!

sentences.simplified: 国家的坏人是你，你就是第二个董卓！”
sentences.traditional: 國家的壞人是你，你就是第二個董卓！”
sentences.pinyin: guó jiā de huài rén shì nǐ nǐ jiù shì dì èr ge dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: It’s you who is the country’s bad guy. You are the next Dong Zhuo!”

sentences.simplified: 虽然他们说的是真话，但是大家都知道，他们不是为了皇帝打仗。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他們說的是真話，但是大家都知道，他們不是為了皇帝打仗。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā men shuō de shì zhēn huà dàn shì dà jiā dōu zhī dào tā men bú shì wèi le huáng dì dǎ zhàng
sentences.english: Although they were telling the truth, everyone knew that they were not fighting this battle for the emperor.

sentences.simplified: 在这个不安静的国家里，皇帝没有军队，皇帝的话没有人听，
sentences.traditional: 在這個不安靜的國家裡，皇帝沒有軍隊，皇帝的話沒有人聽，
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè ge bù ān jìng de guó jiā lǐ huáng dì méi yǒu jūn duì huáng dì de huà méi yǒu rén tīng
sentences.english: In this country without peace, the emperor had no troops, and no one did what the emperor said.

sentences.simplified: 皇帝一点儿都不重要。曹操和元少把皇帝拿出来说，是为了让自己好看点儿，
sentences.traditional: 皇帝一點兒都不重要。曹操和元少把皇帝拿出來說，是為了讓自己好看點兒，
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì yì diǎn'r dōu bú zhòng yào cáo cāo hé yuán shào bǎ huáng dì ná chu lai shuō shì wèi le ràng zì jǐ hǎo kàn diǎn'r
sentences.english: The emperor wasn’t important at all. Cao Cao and Yuan Shao talked about the emperor to make them look better.

sentences.simplified: 他们是为了自己打仗。
sentences.traditional: 他們是為了自己打仗。
sentences.pinyin: tā men shì wèi le zì jǐ dǎ zhàng
sentences.english: They were fighting this battle for themselves.

sentences.simplified: 曹操和元少开始打了。
sentences.traditional: 曹操和元少開始打了。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo hé yuán shào kāi shǐ dǎ le
sentences.english: Cao Cao and Yuan Shao started fighting.

sentences.simplified: 他们的军队一共有一百万人，这一百万人在官渡打了一年多。
sentences.traditional: 他們的軍隊一共有一百萬人，這一百萬人在官渡打了一年多。
sentences.pinyin: tā men de jūn duì yí gòng yǒu yì bǎi wàn rén zhè yì bǎi wàn rén zài guān dù dǎ le yì nián duō
sentences.english: They had one million troops in total, and these one million men fought at Guandu for more than a year.

sentences.simplified: 他们是国家最厉害的军队，他们打的这一仗也是国家最大的一仗。
sentences.traditional: 他們是國家最厲害的軍隊，他們打的這一仗也是國家最大的一仗。
sentences.pinyin: tā men shì guó jiā zuì lì hai de jūn duì tā men dǎ de zhè yí zhàng yě shì guó jiā zuì dà de yí zhàng
sentences.english: They had the most formidable troops in the country. The battle they fought was also the biggest battle in the country.

sentences.simplified: 每天都有人死在官渡，官渡的天都是红色的。
sentences.traditional: 每天都有人死在官渡，官渡的天都是紅色的。
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān dōu yǒu rén sǐ zài guān dù guān dù de tiān dōu shì hóng sè de
sentences.english: Every day people died at Guandu, and the sky in Guandu was red.

sentences.simplified: 最后一个月，曹操的粮食快吃完了。
sentences.traditional: 最後一個月，曹操的糧食快吃完了。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu yí ge yuè cáo cāo de liáng shi kuài chī wán le
sentences.english: In the last month, Cao Cao almost ran out of grain.

sentences.simplified: 没有粮食，军队就不能打仗。曹操很着急，
sentences.traditional: 沒有糧食，軍隊就不能打仗。曹操很著急，
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu liáng shi jūn duì jiù bù néng dǎ zhàng cáo cāo hěn zháo jí
sentences.english: Without grain, the troops couldn’t fight the battle. Cao Cao was very anxious.

sentences.simplified: 给一个弟弟写信，让弟弟想办法找粮食，这是他最后的希望。
sentences.traditional: 給一個弟弟寫信，讓弟弟想辦法找糧食，這是他最後的希望。
sentences.pinyin: gěi yí ge dì di xiě xìn ràng dì di xiǎng bàn fǎ zhǎo liáng shi zhè shì tā zuì hòu de xī wàng
sentences.english: He wrote to a younger brother and asked him to think of a way to find grain. This was his last hope.

sentences.simplified: 曹操把信给了一个助手，让他快点儿去送信。
sentences.traditional: 曹操把信給了一個助手，讓他快點兒去送信。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo bǎ xìn gěi le yí ge zhù shǒu ràng tā kuài diǎn'r qù sòng xìn
sentences.english: Cao Cao gave the letter to an assistant and asked him to hastily deliver the letter.

sentences.simplified: 但是，这个助手还没有走出官渡，就被元少那边一个叫“许右”的人发现了。
sentences.traditional: 但是，這個助手還沒有走出官渡，就被元少那邊一個叫“許右”的人發現了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè ge zhù shǒu hái méi yǒu zǒu chū guān dù jiù bèi yuán shào nà bian yí ge jiào xǔ yòu de rén fā xiàn le
sentences.english: However, before this assistant even left Guandu, he was discovered by a man named “Xu You” from Yuan Shao’s side.

sentences.simplified: 许右是元少的助手，
sentences.traditional: 許右是元少的助手，
sentences.pinyin: xǔ yòu shì yuán shào de zhù shǒu
sentences.english: Xu You was Yuan Shao’s assistant.

sentences.simplified: 他拿到曹操的信，看到曹操说没有粮食了，非常高兴。
sentences.traditional: 他拿到曹操的信，看到曹操說沒有糧食了，非常高興。
sentences.pinyin: tā ná dào cáo cāo de xìn kàn dào cáo cāo shuō méi yǒu liáng shi le fēi cháng gāo xìng
sentences.english: He took Cao Cao’s letter and was very happy to read Cao Cao saying that they had no more grain.

sentences.simplified: 他马上把信拿给元少，让元少去打曹操。
sentences.traditional: 他馬上把信拿給元少，讓元少去打曹操。
sentences.pinyin: tā mǎ shàng bǎ xìn ná gěi yuán shào ràng yuán shào qù dǎ cáo cāo
sentences.english: He immediately gave the letter to Yuan Shao and asked Yuan Shao to fight Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 但是没想到，元少觉得信不是真的，他说：
sentences.traditional: 但是沒想到，元少覺得信不是真的，他說：
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì méi xiǎng dào yuán shào jué de xìn bú shì zhēn de tā shuō
sentences.english: But unexpectedly, Yuan Shao thought that the letter wasn’t real.

sentences.simplified: “如果曹操真的没粮食了，他早就带着军队跑了，怎么还会在官渡？”
sentences.traditional: “如果曹操真的沒糧食了，他早就帶著軍隊跑了，怎麼還會在官渡？”
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ cáo cāo zhēn de méi liáng shi le tā zǎo jiù dài zhe jūn duì pǎo le zěn me hái huì zài guān dù
sentences.english: He said, “If Cao Cao really had no grain, he would already have run away with his troops. Why is he still in Guandu?”

sentences.simplified: 元少还说许右不聪明，总是做错事。
sentences.traditional: 元少還說許右不聰明，總是做錯事。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào hái shuō xǔ yòu bù cōng ming zǒng shì zuò cuò shì
sentences.english: Yuan Shao also said that Xu You was not smart and always did the wrong thing.

sentence_translations: The Battle of Guandu (1)
Cao Cao and Yuan Shao fought their first battle in a place called Guandu.
That day, they stood in front of their troops, looked at each other, and said their last words.
Cao Cao said, “Yuan Shao! Why are you fighting me?”
The emperor is here with me. Fighting me is to fight the emperor. Do you want to be the country’s bad guy?
Yuan Shao said, “Cao Cao! The emperor wrote to me and asked me to fight you!
It’s you who is the country’s bad guy. You are the next Dong Zhuo!”
Although they were telling the truth, everyone knew that they were not fighting this battle for the emperor.
In this country without peace, the emperor had no troops, and no one did what the emperor said.
The emperor wasn’t important at all. Cao Cao and Yuan Shao talked about the emperor to make them look better.
They were fighting this battle for themselves.
Cao Cao and Yuan Shao started fighting.
They had one million troops in total, and these one million men fought at Guandu for more than a year.
They had the most formidable troops in the country. The battle they fought was also the biggest battle in the country.
Every day people died at Guandu, and the sky in Guandu was red.
In the last month, Cao Cao almost ran out of grain.
Without grain, the troops couldn’t fight the battle. Cao Cao was very anxious.
He wrote to a younger brother and asked him to think of a way to find grain. This was his last hope.
Cao Cao gave the letter to an assistant and asked him to hastily deliver the letter.
However, before this assistant even left Guandu, he was discovered by a man named “Xu You” from Yuan Shao’s side.
Xu You was Yuan Shao’s assistant.
He took Cao Cao’s letter and was very happy to read Cao Cao saying that they had no more grain.
He immediately gave the letter to Yuan Shao and asked Yuan Shao to fight Cao Cao.
But unexpectedly, Yuan Shao thought that the letter wasn’t real.
He said, “If Cao Cao really had no grain, he would already have run away with his troops. Why is he still in Guandu?”
Yuan Shao also said that Xu You was not smart and always did the wrong thing.
